newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: UN and WCO join forces to improve drug controls.
newsitem.headline: UN and WCO join forces to improve drug controls.

text.p: The United Nations International Drug Control Programme and the World Customs Organisation will sign an agreement later on Wednesday to increase cooperation between the two in their battle against drug trafficking.

The agreement details the UNDCP's responsibility for coordinating and heading all UN drug control activities and the WCO's role of assisting global customs administration by defining and carrying out drug law enforcement programmes.

According to UNDCP executive director Giorgio Giacomelli, the signing of the memorandum "culminates efforts to reinvigorate cooperation between the two organisations and lays the groundwork for the vigorous development of a mutually beneficial relationship in the years ahead."
